verdict.rationale: Veriff has no native scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs. The closest evidence is its ongoing monitoring (OGM) service, a recurring screening process whose results arrive via webhook. Its Zapier integration automates workflows, but those are triggered by verification decisions rather than run on a schedule. missing for 10: native scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, user-configurable schedules or cron, documentation of how often ongoing monitoring runs and how to configure it, independent corroboration.
